name: Groundhogg

evidence.newsletter: F02: newsletter broadcasts and bulk campaigns
evidence.transactional: F02: transactional and one-off emails, sent through the WordPress mail transport or a configured sender

line: Self-hosted WordPress CRM for newsletters, automation and app email.

free.text: Free core; contacts, flows and emails are unlimited

cells.api: Yes, REST API and configured mail transport

subs.math: AWS connector: $129 a year split over 12 months + $12 server (2GB) + Amazon SES at $0.16 per 1k emails, with 32 KB per email at $0.12 per GB. 1,000 contacts, 4 sends each. Credits and tax excluded.
